description: The data of a page event.

title.description: The title of the page. It is empty when the page is deleted.

url.description: The link to the page in Notion.

change.description: What changed, from the Notion event type, for example created, content_updated, properties_updated, moved, or deleted. A poll gives edited.

database_id.description: The database that holds the page. It is empty for a page outside a database.

last_edited_time.description: The time of the last edit of the page.
